name: MikkTSpace

source.verification: GitHub HTTPS commit archive of the author's repository (head of master = 3e895b49d05ea07e4c2133156cfa94369e19e409), downloaded on 2026-11-21 and its SHA-256 recorded. Upstream publishes no releases, signatures or hashes, so it is pinned by the commit and the archive hash. Imported files are mikktspace.c and mikktspace.h (README.md is not imported).

licenses.upstreamExpression: zlib license text in the header comment of mikktspace.h and mikktspace.c (Copyright (C) 2011 by Morten S. Mikkelsen)

notes: Reference tangent space generator used by the static mesh build (Docs/Design/MeshAnimationAssets.ko.md section 5.2 and decision MA-D5). Pinned to the author's repository (UE ships an older copy with an extra m_bIgnoreDegenerates field; Rocks uses upstream as is, which also has the later all-NaN guard in MergeVertsFast).

Rocks.patch routes cos and acos through hooks backed by Rocks deterministic math (RocksMikkTSpaceCosPi, RocksMikkTSpaceAcos) and malloc/free through the caller's allocator (RocksMikkTSpaceAllocate, RocksMikkTSpaceFree). MeshTools defines the hooks, so only MeshTools links this library. cos(t*pi/180) becomes cospi(t/180), the same function; the default 180 degree threshold gives -1 in both.

The allocation-failure fallback GenerateSharedVerticesIndexListSlow is broken upstream (index2rec is never assigned); Rocks.patch fixes it, and the fixed fallback gives the same tangents as the hashed path (MeshTools allocation failure test). The reference glue builds the same fixed source.

MikkTSpaceReference.c is Rocks glue that rebuilds the same source with the original upstream expressions (CRT cos/acos and malloc/free) under renamed entry points (RocksMikkTSpaceReferenceGenTangSpace*). Only the comparison tests call it; it is never referenced by production code.
The upstream code indexes faces with int (MakeIndex shifts the face index by 2), so callers must keep the face count at or below INT_MAX >> 2.

modifications.reason: Route cos and acos through Rocks deterministic math hooks and malloc/free through allocator hooks (decision MA-D5: the CRT result bits differ between hosts, breaking cooking determinism); store the matched index in GenerateSharedVerticesIndexListSlow (upstream never assigns index2rec, so this allocation-failure fallback wrote -1 into the vertex list and read out of bounds) and start index2rec from the vertex itself so that a vertex nothing matches (NaN input makes veq fail even against itself) keeps its own index; and remove the counters iNumUniqueVerts and iUniqueTspaces that are set but never read: -Wunused-but-set-variable (-Wall)
